summary: The accounts read as a credible set for an IT consultancy sole trader: £409,900 turnover spread sensibly across twelve months, all fourteen purchase codes landing in cost of sales, direct costs or the expense lines, capital spend of £39,000 excluded from the P&L and fully relieved by AIA, and income tax plus Class 4 NI at plausible amounts for a £294,908 taxable profit. A few presentational oddities are noted but none block the run.

concerns.figure: Income Tax £0 alongside "Tax at basic rate" £105,395 (Profit & Loss Acc C30/C32)
concerns.where: Profit & Loss Account, Income Tax and Tax at basic rate lines
concerns.why: The P&L shows Income Tax as zero while the line labelled "Tax at basic rate" carries the full £105,395 of income tax (basic plus higher band). The total tax deducted is right, but the labelling misplaces the figure and a reader would read the tax charge as nil on the face of the P&L.

concerns.figure: SA103S "AIA / WDA claimed" £0 and "WDA + Capital Allowance claimed" £0 (SE Short D85/O80)
concerns.why: The fixed asset schedule and P&L both show £39,000 of AIA claimed, and SA103S box D80 carries capital allowances of £39,000, but the AIA/WDA boxes on the return read zero. Worth checking the return would be filed with the allowance in the correct box.

concerns.figure: SA103S expense analysis: cost of goods £18,540, other direct costs £9,458, other expenses £1,140
concerns.where: Self Assessment (SA103S) section vs Profit & Loss Account expense lines
concerns.why: The SA103S breakdown does not obviously map to the P&L lines (P&L cost of sales £10,540 plus direct costs £8,000; expenses of £57,452 against only £26,438 analysed on the return). Net profit and taxable profit agree, so this looks like a grouping/mapping difference rather than a missing journal, but the allocation between SA103S boxes should be checked.

For an IT consultancy with no payroll, motor costs of £7,598 and an unanalysed "Other Expenses" figure of £17,882 (the largest single expense) are plausible but worth a look — the "other" bucket being the biggest cost is unusual and may indicate codes that should sit in a named line.
